faq.subtitle: Got a question? The answer is probably here.

items.question: Can I try it before I pay?
items.answer: Yes. You get 30 days free, no credit card, with access to everything. Since we don't ask for a card, nothing is charged automatically: at the end of the trial, you decide whether to subscribe.

items.question: How do I subscribe, and how much is it?
items.answer: You subscribe in the Petzara Android app through Google Play. Before you confirm, Google Play shows the price in your currency and the billing date, and you can cancel anytime in Google Play. Card subscriptions on the web aren't available in your country yet.

items.question: How do I get +14 free days?
items.answer: Create appointments on 3 different days during your trial. What counts is the day you create the appointment in Petzara, not the appointment date: if you add the whole week's bookings today, that counts as 1 day. Once you hit the 3rd day, the 14 extra days are added to your trial automatically. One time per account.

items.question: What happens when the trial ends?
items.answer: If you don't subscribe, your account becomes read-only: your clients, pets, appointments and finances stay saved and you can look at everything, but you can't create or edit anything until you subscribe. Subscribe and everything is back instantly.

items.question: Does it send WhatsApp reminders?
items.answer: Not yet. Right now Petzara doesn't send automatic WhatsApp reminders to your clients. What it does: on your booking link, clients see your open slots and are sent to your business WhatsApp to confirm the time with you; and Petzara notifies you and your team in the app, like when a new appointment comes in.

items.question: Can I bring in my clients from a planner or spreadsheet?
items.answer: Yes. In the web app (app.petzara.app), go to Clients › Import and upload a CSV spreadsheet with names and phone numbers (there's a template to download; in Excel, just use "Save as → CSV"). Duplicate phone numbers are skipped. If your clients are in a paper planner, move them to a simple spreadsheet or send them to us on WhatsApp and we'll help.

items.question: Will you help me set it up?
items.answer: Yes, for free, over WhatsApp: we help you add services and prices, business hours, import your clients and turn on your booking link. After that, support continues over WhatsApp and email (suporte@petzara.app) during business hours in Brazil (UTC−3).

items.question: Do I need to install anything on my computer?
items.answer: No. Petzara runs in the browser on your computer, tablet or phone: just go to app.petzara.app. On Android, there's also the Petzara app on Google Play.

items.question: Does it work well on a phone?
items.answer: Yes. On Android, download the Petzara app from Google Play. On iPhone, use it in the browser (Safari or Chrome) at app.petzara.app; you can add it to your home screen. It's the same account on every device.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Your data is stored in the cloud, with an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and hashed passwords, so it doesn't depend on your computer or a paper planner. Only people you invite can access your account, each with the permissions you choose.

items.question: How many team members can I add?
items.answer: Unlimited on both plans. Each team member gets their own login with permissions you set per area: you decide what each person can see and do.

items.question: How does canceling work?
items.answer: No fees and no phone calls. If you subscribed in the Android app, cancel in Google Play under Payments & subscriptions. If you subscribed on the web, cancel anytime in your account settings.

items.question: Is it hard to learn?
items.answer: No. It's designed for people who have never used management software: add your services, create your first appointment and you're up and running. If you get stuck, we'll help over WhatsApp.

items.question: I run a small salon with 1 or 2 employees. Is it worth it?
items.answer: Yes: Petzara is built for small grooming businesses. With the calendar on your team's phones, you stop being the go-between for everything. And you can try it free for 30 days before deciding.
